---
name: Bug report
about: Something in the skill, docs or templates does not work as written
labels: [bug, triage]
---

### Description

A clear and concise description of the problem. What did you ask the
agent, and what went wrong?

### Skill version

The release, tag or commit you are on (for example `v1.0.0` or the commit
SHA from `git log -1`).

### Agent used

Claude Code / Codex / Cursor / Gemini CLI / chat-only (paste mode) /
other (name it).

### Steps to reproduce

1. First step
2. Second step
3. And so on

### Expected behavior

What the skill or docs say should happen.

### Actual behavior

What happened instead. If a hook panel, EDL, humanizer score or QA gate
result is involved, paste it — the numbers are the bug report.

### Logs / output

Paste the relevant agent output below. Trim anything private first.

```
(Paste output here.)
```

### Checklist

- [ ] I reproduced this on the latest `main` or the latest release
- [ ] I searched existing issues for a duplicate
- [ ] The steps above are enough to reproduce without extra context
